description: This file declares the TestService class within the rialto::servermanager namespace. The class provides an interface for managing server state, including starting, stopping, and setting or retrieving application states and log levels. It includes private members for managing server context, synchronization primitives, and dependencies such as StateObserver and IServerManagerService.
